# 🐾 {{liga.nombre}}: Rancho de Kokemones {{rancho.version}}
It's **Monster Rancher 2 DX** with several mods. This summary explains everything that changes **for the player**, so nobody gets an edge from knowing how it works inside. Each item's details are in the **Kokedex** (installed with the game).

## 💻 Installation
1. Install **Monster Rancher 1 & 2 DX** from Steam.
{{?liga.repo}}2. Download the league installer from here: <https://github.com/{{liga.repo}}/releases/latest>
{{?!liga.repo}}2. Ask the admin for the league installer.
3. Unzip it and double-click **`Setup.bat`**.
 - It asks where to install it; Enter uses the suggested folder.
 - It finds the game by itself; if it can't, it asks you to pick `MF2.exe`.
 - If something the game needs is missing (.NET 9 or Visual C++), it installs it.
 - It downloads Reloaded-II and the community mods (about 55 MB) from their official pages.
 - If Windows shows *"Windows protected your PC"*: **More info** → **Run anyway**.

---

## ▶️ Playing
1. **Always** open the game with the **"MR2 Rancho de Kokemones"** desktop shortcut. Otherwise the mods are not loaded.
2. Steam has to be running; if it isn't, the shortcut opens it.
3. **The first time it can take several minutes** to show up, with nothing on screen meanwhile. Wait and don't open it twice.

**Updates:** every time you open the game with the shortcut, it syncs with the league: rivals, tournaments, banners, competitions, rules, the Kokedex and the Rancho version. It still starts without internet. Your saves are never touched.

---

## 🎲 Shrine discs
{{?DiscRandomizer.RandomizeBreed}}- **Each disc gives a random breed, but always the same one.** The same disc gives every player in the league the same breed, so it pays to share what each one gives.
{{?DiscRandomizer.IncludeMoreMonsters}}- The **240+ new More Monsters species** are included.
- **Every created monster is different:**
 - starting stats: ±{{DiscRandomizer.StatVariancePercent}} %
 - each stat's growth: ±{{DiscRandomizer.GrowthVarianceSteps}} level(s)
 - lifespan: ±{{DiscRandomizer.LifespanVariancePercent}} %
 - nature: ±{{DiscRandomizer.NatureVariance}} points
- If the breed is locked, the disc is rejected as in the original game.
{{?RanchRules.ShrineLimitEnabled}}- **At most {{RanchRules.ShrinePerYear}} monsters created per year** at the shrine. The game tells you how many are left, but that number only updates **when you go back to the ranch**.

---

## 💾 Saving (ironman mode)
- Whatever slot you pick, **the game always saves to the Auto slot**, so you can't save before something and reload.
{{?RanchRules.YearlyBackup}}- Every January an automatic copy goes to slots 1 to 7, rotating. They are a safety net, not a way to cheat. **The yearly copies are the ones used to compete in versus mode.**
- **Slots 8 to 14 are for competitions:** they hold each competition's participants (in the freezer, with the trainer "Kokemon"). The Kokemon League admin loads them; they arrive with the updates and appear after the first save of each session. In VS mode you pick that slot and they get registered. If you load one to play, nothing is saved (not even the autosave).

---

## 🏆 Tournaments and battles
{{?RanchRules.BlockLowerRankTournaments}}{{?!RanchRules.LowerRanksAllowed}}- **A monster cannot enter tournaments of a lower rank than its own.** Free (F) tournaments are always open.
{{?RanchRules.BlockLowerRankTournaments}}{{?RanchRules.LowerRanksAllowed}}- **A monster can enter tournaments up to {{RanchRules.LowerRanksAllowed}} rank(s) below its own**, no lower. Free (F) tournaments are always open.
- **Auto battles:** in tournaments and battles **your monster fights by itself**, with its own intelligence. VS mode (against another person) doesn't change.

---

## 🥜 Nuts Oil and Magic Banana
- **They lower fatigue less if given in a row:** Nuts Oil and Magic Banana result A add **2 points** of **anti-fatigue habit**; result B, 1 (maximum {{ItemTolerance.MaxTolerance}}). It drops 1 every week.
- Each point takes {{ItemTolerance.ToleranceStepPercent}} % off how much fatigue drops, down to a minimum of {{ItemTolerance.MinimumEffectPercent}} %. Stress doesn't change.
{{?ItemTolerance.SharedTolerance}}- **It is shared:** alternating Nuts Oil and Magic Banana doesn't dodge it.
- **They are toxic items:** they add **toxicity**, which accumulates over the whole life. Each point gained rolls separately the risk of losing {{ItemTolerance.LifespanWeeksLost}} week(s) of lifespan: {{ItemTolerance.LifespanChancePerItemPercent}} % per toxicity point, capped at {{ItemTolerance.LifespanMaxChancePercent}} %.
- The details (detox items, Green Tea, items that take lifespan) are in the Kokedex.

---

## 👥 Kokemon Rivals
- In league tournaments (E to S), **rivals are drawn every week** from a list per league: the 50 originals plus **monsters from the league's players**. The draw is **the same for everyone** in the same week.
{{?Leagues.ExportOnSave}}- **At the start of each year your monster and the ones in the freezer are exported** to a file named with the game date and your trainer, for example `1021-01-1 Gareth.json`.
{{?Leagues.ExportOnSave}}{{?liga.repo}}- **To share them, use "MR2 Subir exportados"** (desktop shortcut). The first time it asks for the key the admin sends you privately (it's personal: don't share it).

---

## 📅 Kokemon Calendar
{{?CalendarioKokemon.ShuffleSmall}}- **The calendar changes every year:** small A to E tournaments are drawn, how many and when, from a pool with the originals and **the league's new tournaments**. The draw is the same for everyone.
{{?CalendarioKokemon.ShuffleSmall}}- The calendar **shows 7 months ahead**; the other months show last year's.
{{?!CalendarioKokemon.ShuffleSmall}}- Small tournaments keep their original dates, plus **the league's new tournaments**.
- Official and special tournaments stay as always.
